name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis as local caching services, including Redis authentication, Fedora-compatible runtime and log directories, configuration cleanup, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI tutorial application from Git, installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, creates a virtual environment, initializes PostgreSQL as needed, and runs the application through systemd on port 8000.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Builds a multi-site nginx server for three cluster.local virtual hosts with static document roots, HTTPS redirects, self-signed certificates, security controls, rate limiting, fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.
